verdict.rationale: The Division's own NJ portal describes an online service to "file certificates of formation and authorization of business entities". It also offers online name reservation and an online business registration path for tax and employer purposes, with a shared payment account for submitting filings. That covers the founder's core form/register transaction online. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of end-to-end online fee payment and filing steps (only implied via the shared payment account), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the online filing works as described.
